finding_1.why_strength_must_precede_the_recapture: The relevant own decision is choosing the resource-use move Rd6 before the opponent accepts or declines the offered rook. Comparing Nxd6 with another move after Black has already captured the rook answers a different and often elementary recovery question.
finding_1.first_failure_precision: Confirmed absence of an explicit utility requirement in actual supported entries and the typed model. No claim that an existing completed utility requirement was rejected, that its numerical answer is false, or that one uncompleted target question is the sole cause of the whole utility failure.

counterexamples_from_completed_separate_.meaning: Leading f6/Ke6 are nearly tied at881/890cp. The Ke6 conversion uses Kd2 and queenside exchanges, with no White f4/f5 visit. A fixed f4/f5 entry is not a necessary condition of the original bounded root result.
counterexamples_from_completed_separate_.price: Original c3 is lost in the Ke6 route; original a3/b2 identities move through a distinct queenside structure. Equal scores do not merge costs or actors.

counterexamples_from_completed_separate_.meaning: The five complete immediate defenses contain four king moves AND f5. A all-replies-must-be-king gate cannot represent this useful waiting position. The f5 branch instead uses exf5+ and later passed-pawn support.
counterexamples_from_completed_separate_.price: Four king branches lose original e4, and original g3 may be lost as a pawn or its promoted queen. The f5 branch retains/promotes those original pawns. These are separate realizations and prices.
counterexamples_from_completed_separate_.important_negative: Black Kf5 was already illegal from White Kf4/e4 before g4. New g-pawn control cannot be presented as the cause of a newly lost legal defense.

counterexamples_from_completed_separate_.meaning: All five king replies have successful finite conversion witnesses, but immediate Kf4 is illegal after Ke5/Kg5 and later detours reach it. Original e4 has already disappeared. This is one alternative realization, not a universal required checking-g4 event.
counterexamples_from_completed_separate_.boundary: The checking input and quiet input own different histories/inventories. Their facts, costs and numeric receipts are not interchangeable.

finding_3.first_failure_precision: The quoted pure last-wait helper statically rejects the quiet ALL5 input at its legal-enemy-pawn-reply predicate and the checking input at its no-check predicate. This is not an executed product replay with those research receipts. No claim that every current H05 generator is rejected at that same line. Existing bounded H05 product entry/price success remains preserved.
finding_3.root_vs_local: The existing same-f6 Kf3 versus immediate g4 comparison answers the useful timing question at one exact history. Original all8 root outcomes supply a separate bounded defense inventory. Neither silently becomes product16 evidence or proves every later defensive node.

minimal_common_contract_candidate.principle: Keep three independent claims: a canonical board-owned conditional function; an owned value question at the decision to use that resource; and reply-specific current realizations of the same bounded question. A fact remains true when usefulness is unknown or a value claim is refuted.

resource_use_location.quiet_recapture: For proof.reference ending in friendly arrival then enemy capture, locate the exact original friendly-arrival row at reference.size-2 and its decision prefix reference.take(reference.size-2). Do not select the subsequent provider recapture as the value decision.
resource_use_location.other_modes: Derive a resource-use row only from the existing typed action/witness structure and exact owned board. If no unambiguous physical use decision exists, retain a fact-only proof and no utility claim; do not invent a use from prose, SAN or scenario ID.

utility_requirements: An exact current opponent response search and chosen representative/leading response group, bound to root occurrence, original root piece/history, current depth/profile/work/key and child position.

An own resource-use move versus the returned other own plan at the exact same decision history. Select current returned own choices before falling back to a legal hypothesis; hypothetical paths contribute no evaluation.

After selecting the resource-use move, an owned opponent comparison between the named acceptance/capture and the current strongest returned refusal. If several tied/close relevant replies implement different plans, retain their separate response realizations; one convenient capture does not exhaust resistance.
Each result retains its own AnsweredComparison, full line/occurrence identities and actor/victim transition ownership. Numeric freshness/conflict/quality bands are unchanged.
Supported board FactGroup stays separate from the value group's answered/current requirements. Optional utility absent, pending, refuted or stale must not erase a supported LegalReplyOption.

A root-judgment link requires the original numerical root owner AND bounded current resistance evidence for the relevant root alternatives. An off-pair hypothetical proof or one late local answer cannot explain the whole original delta.

Two roots can preserve value through different own moves after different adequate opponent replies. Do not impose the factual proof's identical intervening tail on value/plan survival; keep identical-tail replay only where it proves that specific legal contrast.

Same-role or promoted physical identities, current material account, actual mandatory capture/check/evasion and losses of used original support pieces remain certified and scoped to each displayed realization. No computed price or new future episode is allowed to seed completionSources.
existing_integration_seams: CommentaryDiscovery.emitFunction can attach optional CompareMoves/value context to its existing factual proposal rather than create another motif producer. Existing supported facts remain the factual head.
FunctionalReplyReading.read can expose an additional optional utility reading alongside Proof, without converting RootOwner.answer into a local value receipt.

Reducer existing owned response searches/CompareMoves scheduling can complete the explicit use/refusal obligations and record current unknown/refuted rather than stop as soon as a legal resource is found.

RuntimeProtocol replyFunction context can carry both claims; withAnswer selects a value-qualified synthesis only when its owned utility contract is satisfied, otherwise retains a bounded conditional fact or current purpose with an explicit unresolved judgment scope.

Existing CommentaryIdea comparison/reading machinery may render qualified local results, but mechanismWitness's legal/illegal gate must not be globally weakened and branch-level Key must not be repurposed as an unqualified strategic theorem.
minimal_common_contract_candidate.selection_boundary: Factual specificity and shortest declared proof are not importance/utility rankings. A new resource-use value question should be selected because it answers the actual current judgment question under adequate resistance, not because it has more captures, more relations, a higher motif priority or a shorter sentence. BasicPurposeReading.scala:30-35 currently refuses bare-purpose simplification for an inaccuracy/mistake; preserve this protection and represent an unresolved root cause honestly rather than hiding it.
not_proposed: No root evaluation changes or borrowed research score.
No full lifetime event list as function identity.

meaningful_tests_to_seal_before_implemen.negative: Do not require every reply to release one fixed square or classify Kf5's pre-existing illegality as newly caused by g4. No borrowed checking-g4 all5 answer.

meaningful_tests_to_seal_before_implemen.positive: Only the original/current root receipt and exact owned local resistance/value receipts can support a bounded connection to the root judgment.
meaningful_tests_to_seal_before_implemen.negative: Local Kf3/g4 research128 values, a different primary pair, current child value or completed scheduling report cannot replace product16's original evaluation, claim a sole root cause or promote original0/4.

meaningful_tests_to_seal_before_implemen.negative: Never seed completion from generated price statements, new future episodes or a cost from a different response/actor. Unknown unclosed costs defer that value explanation rather than delete facts or enlarge limits.

recommended_next_evidence_step: Before changing selection, seal the exact NB1 current-response resource-use/refusal questions and the acceptance scope, finish those owned comparisons with the existing requested allowance, then independently read the resulting role/value explanation. Their completion may show Rd6 has only a conditional tactical role and that Nb1's alternative route is sensible; this is a useful result, not a reason to force a positive superiority story. Measure time/cost after completing the necessary comparison, keeping probe completion, value explanation and root-cause explanation separate.
review_limits: No product compiler/test/engine was executed by this reviewer in this turn.
No current runtime overlay or approximate reconstruction was used to assert a new actual first false validator gate.
NB1 facts/query absence were read from its actual exported final snapshot; controlled outcome preservation comes from existing sealed records.
H05 helper rejection is a static contract analysis against independently sealed research inputs, not product delivery evidence.
The common utility contract above is an implementation candidate, not completed behavior or proof that all chess value differences are explained.

investigation_selection_addendum.status: Implementation proposal only. No product edits, new tests, compilers, engines or runtime replays were performed by this reviewer.
investigation_selection_addendum.main_conclusion: Use a small common local-choice contract built from existing CompareMoves and exact owned child searches. Keep conditional board truth independent. Certify why the challenger was selected from a whole legal scope, and obtain both numerical values from one paired work. A local option does not become an explanation of the original root judgment merely because these two local stages finish.

confirmed_scheduler_gaps.gate: Existing proposal answer refresh reads the literal named pair; it does not substitute the class leader into an arbitrary seed requirement.
confirmed_scheduler_gaps.evidence: refreshProposalReadings searches exact prefix and requested reference/alternative moves. The stable functional question key may remain physical, as TargetResponse question IDs do, but its numerical pair realization must keep a distinct immutable owner.

confirmed_scheduler_gaps.gate: A whole legal-class search can omit the named resource from its finite returned top-N set.
confirmed_scheduler_gaps.evidence: Search.representativePair requires coversClass AND pathsByMove(referenceMove). Reserve readers use all legal king or pawn classes and one same-work representative pair; this is safe when both lines returned, but cannot complete a resource absent from returned top3.

The pair does not certify the whole class. Preserve separate survey-selection ownership and paired-value ownership.

confirmed_scheduler_gaps.gate: The existing generic survey-first proposal path is first-ply-only and priority-tuple-specific.
confirmed_scheduler_gaps.evidence: issueProposalChoice surveys only decision==(0,2), prefix size1, no previous unrestricted survey and exploration count<3. A resource-use decision such as Nb1/Nc7/Rd6 is a deeper owned child and will not enter that survey path merely by naming a new CompareMoves.
confirmed_scheduler_gaps.minimal_change: Select an exact typed local-choice dependency independently of producer name. Let the same survey-versus-pair helper operate at that task's certified decision anchor, then let existing issueProposalComparison enforce history, actor legality, profile, depth and deadline. Do not assign a fake first-ply anchor or hard-code an existing priority tuple.

confirmed_scheduler_gaps.gate: Adding pending utility heads alone does not make an already selected functional question finish after the generic exploration cap.
confirmed_scheduler_gaps.evidence: The post-two-exploration completion branch links existing first-reply/reserve/direct-entry dependencies. Its only explicit over-four option is reserve_entry_value, and completed reserve can end investigation before another selected local functional dependency is checked.
confirmed_scheduler_gaps.minimal_change: Include only the exact current selected local-choice task's survey/pair/reply obligations in this existing completion dependency set. Preserve one attempt per exact scope, the current finite-work retry policy, the absolute deadline and explicit stopped/deferred reasons. Do not increase the global topic cap or treat completion count as meaning success. An already completed reserve should not claim an unrelated functional question has been completed.

minimal_local_choice_contract.internal_fields: Canonical physical root owner and root condition; exact decision prefix/occurrences/positions; resource actor and UCI; legally exhaustive alternative scope; optional certified representative selection; optional same-work paired Answer. A reply realization is another local choice at the exact prefix after the resource. Field names are suggestions for a private model, not an instruction to add a new public schema.
minimal_local_choice_contract.no_new_requirement_type: Both numerical stages use existing CommentaryProposal.CompareMoves. Exact legal resource premises use existing Declared/Ply/Predicate/FactGroup fields. Existing Answer already carries work/key/profile/depth, line IDs and occurrences. Keep Proof.board truth and its optional root numeric receipt separate from these optional local value records.
minimal_local_choice_contract.resource_identity: For the actual quiet recapture proof, identify the friendly arrival through the effect.target original physical piece and the certified preceding arrival transition. The current reference ends with that arrival followed by the enemy capture; the decision before the arrival is therefore reference.dropRight(2), verified against actor/transition identity. Do not apply this arithmetic indiscriminately to check-tempo or price proofs; their resource action must be identified from the canonical action/target transition they already prove.
minimal_local_choice_contract.value_question: At the exact position before the friendly resource is used, compare that named resource with the strongest returned other legal own plan. Include all legal alternatives, including captures and promotions, rather than only a convenient quiet seed. A resource that is legal but separated below a better own plan remains a true conditional fact but is not established as an adequate chosen plan.
minimal_local_choice_contract.reply_question: At the exact position after that resource, compare the named capture/acceptance with the strongest returned other legal opponent reply. Other captures and promotions are part of the refusal scope. Do not assume that a capture with the proved recapture is forced, best, or representative of all defenses.
minimal_local_choice_contract.zero_or_singleton_class: If no other legal action exists, record that board fact without manufacturing an identical-move CompareMoves or an Answer. If the scoped class is singleton, its selection needs no ranking comparison, but any comparison against the named resource still needs an owned same-work pair.
minimal_local_choice_contract.current_condition: Before any value adoption, re-read the original root condition and resource physical identity at the exact current decision prefix. Later legal/factual declarations survive unrelated PV suffix changes. A changed current resource, actor, transition or board condition invalidates that local value realization, not the whole historical functional question.

survey_leader_named_pair_certification.action: Select the current exact canonical decision anchor from prepared owned paths and the original physical resource. Use historyAtPrefix/observedPrefix ownership; do not borrow a position reached by another root or by an unowned declaration.

Read the latest sufficient-depth owned unrestricted search at that anchor and profile, or issue one survey when missing. The legal-scope inventory must match the exact current board. A restricted search is class-complete only when it contains every legal class member.

Select the strongest returned line whose first move is in the whole other-plan/refusal class. If the named resource itself is the returned leader, choose the strongest other returned member; do not compare the resource with itself. If a legal class has no returned member, perform the existing missing-class completion shape using all class moves plus the whole-pool leader. Absence from top-N is unknown.

If both named moves are returned with comparisonReady in that survey, use Search.pairAnswer from that work. Otherwise issue a new exact named pair and use only its two values. The earlier survey certifies challenger selection; it supplies no score to be spliced into the named pair.

Validate the two owners together: packet identity, root move/occurrence, full decision prefix and transitions, child position ID, profile, sufficient compatible depth, selected challenger UCI and the exact selected line origin. Pair Answer must equal pairAnswer for its claimed work/key and own both values. Extend FirstTarget's take(2)/take(3) checks to decisionPrefix.size+1 occurrences and decisionPrefix.size+2 positions; do not hard-code first-ply checks for a deeper resource.

After a newer sufficient survey changes the selected challenger, invalidate only the old representative-selection link. The old pair can remain historical; it cannot describe the current strongest other plan. A new selected challenger requires a distinct pair realization, even if a convenient old answer exists.

adequate_first_response_scope.existing_behavior: Search.selectedLinePairs forms a leader star over ALL returned peers. investigationPrefixRelation retains those paths from the latest unrestricted pool plus subsequent named comparisons. Neither method filters numerical near-best peers.
adequate_first_response_scope.bounded_reuse: Use the latest exact owned first-response unrestricted pool for each root. Its actual leader is obligatory resistance. A near-best group can reuse same-work leader-versus-peer Answer.qualityBand==Close, whose definition requires forward and reverse MoveChoiceVerdict MatchesReference/PlayableLoss. This is an existing numerical quality rule, not a new arbitrary centipawn threshold.
adequate_first_response_scope.unknown_boundary: A missing quality reading, a class omitted from finite top-N, or an insufficient-depth pool is unknown, not weak. A bounded top-N survey is not individual exhaustive validation of all legal first replies. Keep that finite inventory boundary visible.
adequate_first_response_scope.different_realizations: Current Nb1/Nc7 and Nc4/Nef6 can lead to different own plans. Join local choice evidence to its own root/resistance prefix; do not demand the same first reply, Rd6 tail or PV suffix for both. Conversely, value proved after conditional Nef6 cannot be attributed to Nb1/Nc7 merely because the root board condition is the same.
adequate_first_response_scope.numeric_noncomparison: Do not compare absolute scores from two separate roots or surveys to define a plan-value difference. Same-work pair values support each local judgment. Root numeric grading remains on its original root paired receipt and profile.

fail_closed_root_connection.needed_for_local_value: Current board proof plus canonical resource decision; whole-scope representative selection; same-work own-choice pair; and, when the conditional capture is used as the mechanism, its same-work acceptance-versus-refusal pair. Required actual captures/check replies/used support losses close within their physical Sections, not by taking the complete history ledger.
fail_closed_root_connection.needed_for_original_judgment: The current authoritative paired root receipt, actual played root membership, and locally adequate plans under the current strongest/qualified near-best immediate defenses. If another root preserves an equally adequate different plan, state that plan and the limitation of the claimed functional advantage. Establishing one useful conditional option is not establishing the cause of a small root score difference.
fail_closed_root_connection.positive_claim_level: It is defensible to say that under a named adequate response, a particular own plan stays adequate against its strongest returned refusal and uses the root-owned resource at these exact prices. It is not yet a general theorem that this resource caused the original numerical advantage or that the PV is forced.
fail_closed_root_connection.unknown: Pending/absent/stopped value receipts leave local utility unestablished. Keep the already verified legal conditional fact, possibly as purpose/detail, and keep the original numerical judgment; do not invent its cause or turn deferred into refuted.
fail_closed_root_connection.refuted: A resource separated below the best other own plan, or a stronger refusal that defeats the supposed benefit, rejects that value realization. It does not make the original legal capture/recapture fact false. Alternative adequate plans can answer a different current plan question without borrowing the refuted proof's numerical owner.
fail_closed_root_connection.off_pair: The existing legal off-pair carrier allowance does not authorize importing an off-pair conditional plan as the cause of the current main pair. Actual played root inclusion and the main root-condition vector remain necessary. A third unrelated played root or different canonical actor condition cannot borrow the function receipt.
fail_closed_root_connection.freshness: Board conditions must be replayed on their exact current canonical prefix. Numerical minDepth/profile/receipt validity remain unchanged globally. A PV realization can change while its resource remains useful, but the changed realization needs its own current receipt and prices.

CurrentDuty_reuse.confirmed_now: currentDuties appears only in CommentaryIdea and proposal dependency scheduling; no RuntimeProtocol typed root-context field or MoveWorkProjection delivery consumer exists for CurrentDuty. Its two explicit choices already use CompareMoves and can represent two legal own plans.

invariant.resource: Original friendly physical actor plus proposed destination, legal own action at the exact pre-use decision prefix, and independently verified canonical root condition/provider/control. These can be revalidated in another owned first-response history.
invariant.not_invariant: The old enemy capture, the recapture SAN/UCI, the old stationary supporting piece location, the entire declared tail, and an old returned PV are individual realization witnesses. They must not be required unchanged by the generic local-choice value certificate.
invariant.facts_survive: An absent old Qxd6 action at a new exact child makes that old realization inapplicable there. It does not erase its earlier board proof or prove that the friendly resource has lost value.
invariant.control_scope: Independently read provider physical presence, legal control/recapture and resource legality at the actual pre-use prefix. A same-square attack from a different physical provider is a replacement relation, not the unchanged original root-owned resource.

current_reply_boundaries: If the original named acceptance is still legal at the current exact post-resource position, a capture-versus-best-other reply CompareMoves can use the shared whole-other-legal-scope certificate.

If that acceptance is illegal there, do not invent a CompareMoves with an illegal reference, reuse a score from its old conditional child, or call it a forced/current defense. The old fact stays attached to its own exact history.

A current unrestricted post-resource survey can identify the actual strongest returned response among ALL legal replies. Its PV/prices belong to this new realization. An optional acceptance comparison is needed only when the acceptance remains legal and its adequacy matters to the mechanism claim.

The refusal scope includes quiet defenses, other captures, checks, promotions and evasions that are legal on the current board. It cannot be narrowed to only the old opponent piece or to non-captures unless the claim explicitly names that smaller class.

An engine-owned own-plan pair already values that plan under engine-best play; a later opponent survey verifies concrete resistance coverage. Lack of the old acceptance does not make that own-plan pair unowned, but it limits the explanatory event story.

alternative_plan_substitution.allowed: The certified current best other own plan can replace the proposed own PLAN under the same original root and current resistance, with its own paired value and exact witness/prices.
alternative_plan_substitution.not_allowed: A different own actor/destination cannot automatically be relabelled a realization of the original control/resource FUNCTION merely because it is numerically adequate. The root-controlled d6 recapture does not explain an unrelated good plan by receipt association alone.
alternative_plan_substitution.minimum_for_functional_title: If the replacement is presented under the same functional title, it must independently use or preserve the original canonical condition/provider/resource, or expose a verified transformation/replacement of that condition. Otherwise report an adequate alternative plan with the functional causal link still unestablished.
alternative_plan_substitution.CurrentDuty_implication: Duty can consume the same numerical local-choice certificate for two legal plans. A stronger adjustment/best-other plan is not proof that the original support change caused its strength; the independent duty-context and current resource dependence still determine the explanation.

sound_admission_boundaries.finding: Selection uses an owned unrestricted survey at the exact prefix and current requested profile with sufficient required depth; deeper request target wins and recency breaks a tie.
The named resource must be legal on the certified pool board. Strongest other means the first ranked returned different legal move, not a caller-supplied convenient quiet candidate.
The selected challenger must equal the named pair alternative. The pair belongs to the exact same anchor/profile and supplies both values through Search.pairAnswer; no survey/pair score graft exists.

Reference, alternative and selected pool paths must belong to the same PreparedPaths object. Full decision prefix occurrences/positions and the selected challenger transition match. Later PV suffix identity is not imposed.
Checked binds packet+prepared object owners and interprets same-work relation/Close quality only as local resource competitiveness. It does not mutate a root receipt.

The current five proposed tests distinguish omitted resource plus named pair, partial pair/no arbitrary weaker alternative, same-survey close value, requested-depth/prefix/foreign owner mismatch, and a newly selected survey representative.

depth_admission_edge.scope: This is an edge in the new local certificate, not evidence that actual product inputs have hit it or that the old root numeric contract should be weakened.

consumer_obligations_still_outside_modul: The caller must supply the current adequate minimumDepth/profile. Without the active investigation threshold, an older sufficient-looking survey and pair could remain valid historical local values but cannot be certified current.

adequateReplies accepts any owned unrestricted Search; current freshness/profile/minDepth must be selected through survey before using it as current first-response coverage. A missing pair quality cannot be treated as proof that that returned peer is weak.

Checked.useful means locally competitive with its certified best returned other own choice. It does not mean winning, safe material profit, compensation for a sacrifice, or cause of the original root grade. Both local choices can be losing.

The functional adapter must independently revalidate original resource actor/destination/provider/control on the exact current first-response history. This common numeric module intentionally does not establish that physical semantic relation.
If the old acceptance capture is illegal after a new response, current plan value can still be read, but old capture/recapture facts cannot serve as that history's resistance or price witness.

An unrelated best other own plan is an owned alternative plan, not automatically a realization of the original d6-control title. Original root cause remains unknown until the cross-root adequate-defense/resource connection is independently closed.
followup_controls_to_add_if_needed: Uniform returned pair depth exceeds its requested target and the completed pool depth, while all work targets match.
A newer shallow survey must not evict an adequate deeper current pool; after current minimumDepth increases, a below-threshold pair cannot be revived by a deep survey.
A close/value-missing returned first-reply peer is unknown rather than removed from required coverage as weak.
Changed first reply preserves the physical resource but removes the old acceptance: local choice remains ownable while old realization is inapplicable.
The resource is locally competitive while its original provider/control has disappeared: numerical local value remains true but functional/root contribution is refused.
Both own plans are losing but close: locally competitive label cannot imply a successful attack or sufficient sacrifice compensation.
